text: UT Southwestern Medical Center originated in 1949 when the University of Texas Board of Regents accepted an offer to establish Southwestern Medical School of The University of Texas in Dallas; it was renamed The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center in 1987.

source.name: UT Southwestern - 'Mission, Values, and History' (About Us)
source.quote: The Board of Regents accepted this offer from the Foundation, and in 1949 the college became Southwestern Medical School of The University of Texas.
